title: A Common Pool of Privacy Problems: Legal and Technical Lessons from a Large-Scale Web-Scraped Machine Learning Dataset
reasoning: The paper is a privacy audit and legal analysis of a large-scale dataset used to train AI models. While it includes a section on 'Ethical considerations' and identifies religious affiliation as a type of sensitive personally identifiable information (PII) to illustrate privacy risks, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, morals, or ethics as its primary component.
